verdict: Meta delivering leads efficiently; Google spend needs an immediate fix.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 141 leads at $15.63 per lead across $2,203.80 in total spend — all of that lead volume came from Meta. Google Ads consumed $495.93 in the same window and produced zero conversions, so that budget is being addressed now rather than carried into next period. On the pipeline side, 141 leads entered your system but no appointments or closed opportunities have been recorded, which points to a follow-up gap we are actively working to close. Google Business Profile engagement dropped sharply in the most recent week, and that is also under review. Expect Google Ads to be restructured before the end of September, with offline conversion tracking going live to give that channel a real signal for the first time.
